quote: If any driver or operator of a motor vehicle drives or operates a motor vehicle at a speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator, the driver or operator shall: If the highway has one lane for traveling in each direction and the width of the paved portion permits, drive to the extreme right side of the highway and, if applicable, comply with the provisions of NRS 484B.630.

activation.description: The motor vehicle operates so slowly that it impedes traffic immediately behind on a highway with one lane in each direction and enough paved width.
activation.source_clause: speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator

obligation.description: Drive to the extreme right side; NRS 484B.630 compliance is conditional and separately reviewed.
obligation.source_clause: drive to the extreme right side of the highway and, if applicable, comply with the provisions of NRS 484B.630

timing.description: Evaluate during the observed slow operation and following traffic interaction.
timing.source_clause: drives or operates a motor vehicle at a speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator
